scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json
scripts.package:site: npm run build && npm run package:site:from-build
scripts.test:wasm: cargo test -p ofg_web status_json_contains_browser_contract_fields && cargo test -p ofg_web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo check -p ofg_web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.test:ts: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --import ./dist-test/tests/ts/setupDom.js ./node_modules/mocha/bin/mocha.js "dist-test/tests/ts/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:ts
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:browser && npm run smoke:render
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:rust && npm run coverage:ts
